top_signals.title: US Stocks Fall as Yields Climb to Multi-Year Highs: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: A stalemate between the US and Iran boosted oil prices, dragging down stocks and bonds on concerns that elevated energy costs could fuel inflation and trigger further Federal Reserve rate hikes.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Airlink founder Steve Smith named to lead Airforwarders Association
top_signals.summary:
The Airforwarders Association has appointed Steve Smith, with a long record in disaster response logistics, as its new executive director in Washington.

The post Airlink founder Steve Smith named to lead Airforwarders Association appeared first on FreightWaves.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Vietnam Air Jet Deployed Brakes Twice Before Botched Takeoff
top_signals.summary: A Boeing Co. 787 aircraft operated by Vietnam Airlines JSC had its brakes activated twice while barreling down the runway at Munich Airport last month, leading to a perilously late takeoff and the plane’s tail striking the ground, a report found.

top_signals.summary: Some stolen assets have been frozen, but Bitget has yet to disclose how much has been recovered as investigators continue to assess a possible North Korea link.
